headline: Meditation Practice, from entry to detail
overview:
The Meditation Practice tool is your personal meditation space, offering 8 guided meditation techniques in a beautiful, distraction-free environment. From Open Awareness to Loving-Kindness (Metta), Body Scan, Walking Meditation, and more — each technique comes with detailed step-by-step instructions so you can practice even if you've never meditated before.

Sessions range from 5 to 30 minutes, and the immersive full-screen timer features a calming animated orb with customizable visual themes and ambient sounds. It's designed to help you build a consistent meditation habit with zero friction.
targetAudience: Anyone looking to start or deepen a meditation practice. Whether you're a complete beginner curious about mindfulness or an experienced meditator wanting a simple, beautiful timer — the detailed instructions and variety of techniques make it accessible to all levels.

steps.title: Landing Page — Your Meditation Space
steps.description:
When you open the Meditation tool, you'll see a clean, centered interface. A large purple orb displays the current meditation category ("Simply Be" for Open Awareness), with the technique name below it. Duration buttons let you choose 5, 10, 15, 20, or 30 minutes — 10 minutes is selected by default.

At the bottom, "Instructions" shows you how to practice the technique, and "Change" lets you browse all available meditation styles.
steps.screenshotAlt: Meditation landing page showing the purple orb with Simply Be label, Open Awareness Meditation title, duration selector, and Start Meditation button

steps.title: Choose a Meditation Technique
steps.description:
Tap "Change" to open the technique selector. You'll see 8 meditation styles to choose from:

- Body Scan Meditation — lying down or seated
- Loving-Kindness (Metta) — hands on heart
- Open Awareness Meditation — relaxed alertness
- Breath & Mantra Meditation — spine erect
- Walking Meditation — standing, slow walking
- Gratitude Meditation — prayer position or hands on heart
- Flame Gazing (Trataka) — flame at eye level
- Noting Practice — seated comfortably

Each shows the posture recommendation and default duration. The currently selected technique has a purple highlight and checkmark.

steps.title: Read the Instructions
steps.description:
Tap "Instructions" to see detailed, numbered guidance for your chosen meditation. For Open Awareness, you'll see 14 steps walking you through posture (sit with back straight but not rigid), preparation (three deep breaths to arrive), the core practice (open awareness without focusing on any one thing), how to handle wandering thoughts (label them gently as "thinking" or "planning"), and a beautiful reminder: "You are the sky. Everything else is weather passing through."

Every technique has its own unique instruction set tailored to that practice style.

steps.title: Active Meditation Session
steps.description:
Hit "Start Meditation" and the screen transforms into an immersive, dark meditation environment. A large animated orb pulses gently at the center with the meditation category label. A prominent countdown timer shows your remaining time in large, easy-to-read digits.

Below the timer, Pause and Reset buttons give you full control. You can also tap "Instructions" during the session if you need a reminder. Press ESC or the X button in the top-right to end early.

steps.title: Customize Your Experience
steps.description:
During an active session, two buttons in the bottom-right corner let you personalize the environment. The theme button reveals 4 visual themes that change the orb's color and animation style. The sound button lets you toggle ambient background sounds to enhance your meditation.

These customization options let you create the atmosphere that works best for your practice — whether you prefer a minimal, quiet session or a more immersive audiovisual experience.

keyFeatures: 8 meditation techniques spanning mindfulness, compassion, body awareness, and concentration
Immersive full-screen timer with animated orb visualization
Flexible session duration from 5 to 30 minutes
Detailed step-by-step instructions for every technique
4 visual themes to customize the meditation environment
Ambient sound options for enhanced immersion
Pause, reset, and resume controls during sessions
Posture guidance for each meditation style
tips: Start with Open Awareness or Breath & Mantra if you're new to meditation — they're the most accessible
Begin with 5-minute sessions and gradually increase as your practice develops
Try Loving-Kindness (Metta) when you're feeling stressed about relationships
Walking Meditation is a great option when you're too restless to sit still
Read the instructions before your first session with a new technique, then let the timer guide you
Gratitude Meditation pairs well with the Gratitude journaling tool in Inner Quest
